stories.story_fr: BNT a annonce l'acquisition de Just Group plc, specialiste britannique de la retraite, transformant son positionnement sur le marche UK de la retraite (de-risking de regimes a prestations definies et revenus de retraite individuels). Cloture attendue au 1er semestre 2026.
stories.story_en: BNT announced the acquisition of Just Group plc, a U.K.-based retirement specialist, transforming its footprint in the UK retirement market (defined benefit de-risking and individual retirement income). Closing expected in H1 2026.
stories.quote: Our recently announced acquisition of Just Group plc. will be transformational to our business as we expand in the U.K. retirement market, serving as an attractive platform for future growth.

stories.short: Premier accord de reassurance au Japon
stories.story_fr: Le 30 septembre 2025, BNT a annonce son premier accord de reassurance base au Japon, effectif en octobre 2025, marquant une avancee majeure de son expansion internationale en Asie.
stories.story_en: On 30 September 2025, BNT announced its first Japan-based reinsurance agreement, effective October 2025, marking a major step in its international expansion into Asia.
stories.quote: On September 30, 2025, we announced our first Japan-based reinsurance agreement, which became effective in October 2025.

stories.story_fr: Sur l'exercice 2025, BNT a deploye 13 milliards $ dans des strategies originees par Brookfield a un rendement moyen de 8,5%, repositionnant son portefeuille vers des actifs reels a plus haut rendement.
stories.story_en: In FY2025, BNT deployed $13 billion into Brookfield-originated strategies at an average yield of 8.5%, repositioning its portfolio into higher-yielding real asset strategies.
stories.quote: Deployed $13 billion into Brookfield originated strategies across our investment portfolio at an average yield of 8.5%.

stories.short: 20 Md$ de ventes de rentes en 2025
stories.story_fr: BNT a originé 20 milliards $ de ventes de rentes sur l'exercice 2025 a travers ses canaux retail, pension et funding agreement, demontrant la montee en puissance de sa plateforme de distribution.
stories.story_en: BNT originated $20 billion of annuity sales in FY2025 across its retail, pension and funding agreement channels, demonstrating the scaling of its distribution platform.
stories.quote: Originated $20 billion of annuity sales across our retail, pension and funding agreement channels.

stories.story_fr: Fin 2025, BNT disposait d'environ 35 milliards $ de liquidites et placements liquides a court terme, plus environ 26 milliards $ de placements liquides a long terme, securisant ses obligations envers les assures et la rotation du portefeuille.
stories.story_en: At end-2025, BNT held approximately $35 billion of cash and short-term liquid investments, plus around $26 billion of long-term liquid investments, securing policyholder obligations and portfolio rotation.
stories.quote: we are in a strong liquidity position, with approximately $35 billion of cash and short-term liquid investments across our investment portfolios, and another approximately $26 billion of long-term liquid investments.
